#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int solve(vector<char>& s, char x) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
        if (s[i] == 'X') {
            s[i] = x;
        }
    }
    if (s[0] == '0') {
        return 0;
    }
    int ans = 1;
    bool first = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            ans *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
        } else if (s[i] == 'X' && first) {
            ans *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
            first = false;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

bool canReplace(const vector<char>& s, char a, char b) {
    size_t n = s.size();
    if (n >= 2) {
        if (s[n - 2] >= '0' && s[n - 2] <= '9' && s[n - 2] != a) {
            return false;
        }
        if (s[n - 1] >= '0' && s[n - 1] <= '9' && s[n - 1] != b) {
            return false;
        }
        if (s[n - 2] == 'X' && s[n - 1] == 'X' && a != b) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    string input;
    getline(cin, input);
    vector<char> s(input.begin(), input.end());

    if (s.size() < 2) {
        cout << ((s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X') ? 1 : 0) << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int ans = 0;
    vector<pair<char, char>> replacements = { {'0', '0'}, {'2', '5'}, {'5', '0'}, {'7', '5'} };

    for (auto& rep : replacements) {
        if (canReplace(s, rep.first, rep.second)) {
            vector<char> t = s;
            size_t n = t.size();
            t[n - 2] = rep.first;
            t[n - 1] = rep.second;
            if (t[n - 2] == 'X') {
                ans += solve(t, t[n - 2]);
            } else if (t[n - 1] == 'X') {
                ans += solve(t, t[n - 1]);
            } else {
                ans += solve(t, 'X');
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
